$comment: The ONE list of packages the server bundle (app/server.cjs, app/karizctl.cjs) does not inline. scripts/build-server.mjs marks them external and copies each installed one with its dependency closure into app/node_modules. 'native' packages are optional and loaded lazily (Windows SSO: the AD engineer's kerberos or node-expose-sspi); their prebuilt win32-x64 binaries arrive with `npm ci` on the Windows CI runner (prebuild-install / node-gyp-build), never at install time on the bank's server. A listed package that is not installed is skipped with a note. 'unused' packages are imported by code the server edition never runs (the Windows app's PGlite) and are neither bundled nor shipped. 'files' limits what is copied of a package to the listed paths (no dependency closure): node-expose-sspi's raw binding is lib/api.js, which requires ./arch/<process.arch>/node-expose-sspi.node — src/server/auth/sso.ts loads it by name through createRequire from app/ (the folder of server.cjs) or ITSM_NODE_MODULES_DIR; its high-level dist/ and their dependencies (node-fetch beta, ...) are never used.
